links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of ChatGPT-4o responses before and after 'explain in simpler terms' prompt
links.effect: Simplification prompt improved readability significantly (mean FKGL: 4.9; FRE: 79.0) without altering content; baseline English responses required college-level literacy (FKGL 10.5, FRE 37.8).
